think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s normal domain and meaning. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a different mode (disable/auto/inherit). 3) Determine whether that sentinel breaks the natural numeric ordering by changing semantics rather than just scaling. 4) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
